controls.regle: The application has an up-to-date map of its components, flows, and internal dependencies, referenced in the information system inventory.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of an application map (components, flows, dependencies) and its last update date; verify its consistency with the actually deployed architecture.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated application mapping diagram or document + excerpt from the information system inventory.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = map up to date (< 6 months) and consistent with what is deployed ; partial = map exists but outdated or partially consistent ; non-compliant = no application map
actions_audit: Request the application map and verify its last update date.
Compare the declared map against the actually deployed architecture (sample of components).
If gap: have the map produced or updated and recorded in the information system inventory.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des configurations de service

controls.regle: Application components exhibit low coupling and high cohesion; component boundaries are aligned with distinct business responsibilities.
controls.verification: Analyze the breakdown of components (modules, services) and assess their coupling (cross dependencies, state sharing) with respect to the business responsibilities they carry.
controls.preuve_attendue: Code or configuration excerpts illustrating component boundaries + diagram of inter-component dependencies.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = low coupling, boundaries aligned with clear business responsibilities ; partial = moderate coupling or partially consistent boundaries ; non-compliant = widespread strong coupling, unidentifiable boundaries
actions_audit: Analyze inter-component dependencies (imports, calls, database sharing) and map the actual coupling.
Compare the observed component boundaries against the expected business responsibilities.
If gap: recommend a decoupling plan prioritized on the most coupled components.

controls.regle: Architecture choices (components, patterns, services) comply with the internal reference catalog; any deviation is identified and justified.
controls.verification: Compare the components and patterns used against the internal reference catalog (approved services, recommended patterns) and record the deviations.
controls.preuve_attendue: Compliance matrix against the reference catalog + documented justification for each identified deviation.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of choices compliant with the catalog or deviations justified and validated ; partial = deviations identified but not justified/validated ; non-compliant = choices outside the catalog not recorded
actions_audit: Establish the list of components and patterns used and compare them against the internal reference catalog.
For each identified deviation, verify the existence of a justification and a validation by the decision-making authority.
If an unjustified deviation exists: have it migrated to the catalog or initiate the exception validation procedure.
standards: TOGAF — ADM Phase G (revue de conformité architecturale)

controls.regle: The application has distinct, segregated environments (development, test, production at a minimum), with a documented promotion chain and an explicit transfer of responsibility.
controls.verification: Verify the existence and actual segregation of the required environments, and the existence of a documented procedure for promotion between environments with transfer of responsibility.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of environments with their segregation + documented promotion procedure.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = segregated environments and a documented, followed promotion procedure ; partial = environments present but segregation or procedure incomplete ; non-compliant = single environment or no segregation
actions_audit: Identify the existing environments and verify their segregation (access, data, configuration).
Verify the existence and actual application of a promotion procedure between environments.
If gap: have the missing environments created and formalize the promotion chain.
standards: DORA (Accelerate) — capacité de gestion des environnements de test et de déploiement
ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des déploiements

controls.regle: Critical architecture components have no unidentified and unmitigated single point of failure (SPOF); resilience mechanisms (redundancy, failover, rollback) are documented and tested.
controls.verification: Identify the architecture's critical components and verify for each the existence of a resilience mechanism (redundancy, failover, rollback strategy) and proof of a recent test of that mechanism.
controls.preuve_attendue: Map of critical components with associated resilience mechanism + resilience or rollback test report.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = SPOFs identified and mitigated, resilience mechanisms tested ; partial = SPOFs identified but mitigation not tested ; non-compliant = SPOF not identified or not mitigated on a critical component
actions_audit: Map the critical components and identify potential single points of failure.
Verify the existence and recent testing of resilience mechanisms (redundancy, failover, rollback) for each identified SPOF.
If gap: prioritize the mitigation of critical SPOFs before any industrialization decision.
standards: DORA (Accelerate) — fiabilité et délai de rétablissement

controls.regle: Architectural debt (deviations from target principles, technical workarounds) is identified, qualified, and tracked in a prioritized register.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of an architectural debt register, the qualification of each item (impact, effort), and its tracking over time.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated architectural debt register with qualification and remediation status.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = debt recorded, qualified, and tracked with a prioritized remediation plan ; partial = debt identified but not qualified or not tracked ; non-compliant = no identification of architectural debt
actions_audit: Request the architectural debt register and verify the qualification (impact, effort) of each item.
Verify the existence of a prioritized remediation plan and its actual progress.
If gap: have the unidentified debt recorded and integrate its remediation into the remediation plan.
standards: COBIT 2019 — BAI03 (gérer l'identification et la construction des solutions)

controls.regle: A target architecture diagram, formalized according to a standardized representation (components, flows, boundaries), is produced, up to date, and accessible to stakeholders.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a formalized architecture diagram (components, flows, boundaries, legend), its last update date, and its accessibility to the relevant stakeholders.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated target architecture diagram + proof of accessibility (shared location, documentation link).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = diagram exists, up to date, accessible, and compliant with the standardized representation ; partial = diagram exists but outdated or non-standardized ; non-compliant = no architecture diagram
actions_audit: Request the target architecture diagram and verify its compliance with the expected standardized representation (components, flows, boundaries).
Verify the last update date and its consistency with the actually deployed architecture.
If gap: have the diagram produced or updated and made accessible to stakeholders.
standards: ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022 — 5.3 (description d'architecture, vues et points de vue)

controls.regle: The application's external dependencies (third-party services, shared components, upstream/downstream platforms) are inventoried along with their criticality and management approach.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of an inventory of external dependencies with their criticality level, owner, and management approach (contract, SLA, failover procedure).
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of external dependencies with criticality, owner, and associated management approach.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = external dependencies inventoried, criticality qualified, and management approach defined ; partial = incomplete inventory or unqualified criticality ; non-compliant = no inventory of external dependencies
actions_audit: Request the inventory of external dependencies and verify its completeness by cross-checking against the actual architecture.
Verify the criticality qualification and the existence of a management approach for each critical dependency.
If gap: have the inventory completed and define the management approach for uncovered dependencies.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des fournisseurs

controls.regle: The architecture's sizing (compute, storage, network resources) is made explicit and justified with regard to a declared target load, with a documented margin.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a documented target load assumption and the justification of the sizing adopted (allocated resources, safety margin) with regard to that load.
controls.preuve_attendue: Sizing document with target load assumptions, allocated resources, and retained margin.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = sizing documented, justified by an explicit target load and a reasonable margin ; partial = sizing exists but not justified or target load implicit ; non-compliant = no documented sizing
actions_audit: Request the target load assumptions and the associated sizing document.
Verify the consistency between the allocated resources, the declared target load, and the retained margin.
If gap: have the load assumptions formalized and adjust the sizing accordingly.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion de la capacité

controls.regle: Structuring architecture decisions are tracked in a decision register (context, options considered, choice made, consequences), accessible and up to date.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of an architecture decision register covering the structuring choices, the presence of the expected fields (context, options, choice, consequences), and its update upon major changes; a format check can verify the structure of the entries.
controls.preuve_attendue: Architecture decision register with, for a sample, context/options/choice/consequences filled in.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = structuring decisions tracked, complete, and up to date ; partial = register exists but incomplete or outdated ; non-compliant = no traceability of architecture decisions
actions_audit: Request the architecture decision register and verify its structure on a sample.
Compare known structuring decisions (tech lead interviews) against their actual presence in the register.
If gap: have the missing decisions tracked retroactively and establish the traceability discipline for subsequent ones.

controls.regle: The shared platform / application workload zoning is documented in the map and watertight: no application resource resides within the platform zone's perimeter.
controls.verification: Compare the zone map against the actual resource inventory; look for any application resource deployed within the platform's management perimeter.
controls.preuve_attendue: Zone map + resource inventory by zone (dated extraction).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete and watertight zoning ; partial = zoning documented with tracked exceptions ; non-compliant = untracked mixing between platform and application
actions_audit: Request the zone map and the resource inventory; attach both.
Cross-check the inventory against the declared perimeter of the platform zone; list any deviation.
If gap: plan the migration of application resources out of the platform zone.

controls.regle: No significant inter-application exchange bypasses the trusted exchange intermediary (API gateway, event bus); any exception is documented and dated.
controls.verification: Inventory the inter-application flows (map + network configuration) and verify that they pass through the recorded trusted intermediary; identify direct links.
controls.preuve_attendue: Map of inter-application flows with, for each, the observed passage point.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of flows via the trusted intermediary or a tracked exception ; partial = a minority of direct links documented after the fact ; non-compliant = untracked direct links
actions_audit: Extract the list of the application's outbound/inbound integrations; attach the map.
Verify for each flow the actual passage point (configuration, access logs).
If gap: switch the flow to the profile's trusted intermediary or document the exception.
standards: OWASP ASVS 5.0 — V4 (API et services web)

controls.regle: No inter-organization file exchange transits outside the recorded trusted managed service (no ad hoc sharing: messaging, personal storage, removable media).
controls.verification: Inventory the inbound/outbound file exchanges and their actual channel; look for ad hoc channels in the documentation, configurations, and interviews.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of file exchanges with the observed channel for each.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = all exchanges via the recorded managed service ; partial = ad hoc channels identified with a resolution plan ; non-compliant = untracked active ad hoc channels
actions_audit: List the file flows and their channel; attach the inventory.
Verify the managed service's configuration (traceability, encryption, access expiration).
If gap: migrate the flow to the managed service and close the ad hoc channel.

controls.regle: Each deprecated API version carries a published and honored retirement deadline; no overdue version remains accessible.
controls.verification: Extract the register of exposed API versions; verify for each deprecated version the existence of a published deadline and the actual inaccessibility of expired versions.
controls.preuve_attendue: Version register with status/deadline + access test on expired versions.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = deadlines published and honored ; partial = published deadlines not met, with a plan ; non-compliant = deprecated versions accessible with no deadline
actions_audit: Request the register of API versions and their statuses; attach the excerpt.
Test access to a version announced as retired; attach the result.
If gap: publish the retirement deadline and cut off access to expired versions.

controls.regle: A reversibility plan exists: export of all data and configurations in usable, documented formats, tested at least once.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of the reversibility plan, the documented export formats, and the trace of a complete export test.
controls.preuve_attendue: Reversibility plan + inventory of exports (formats) + dated test report.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = plan documented and tested ; partial = plan documented but not tested ; non-compliant = no documented export capability
actions_audit: Request the reversibility plan and the export formats; attach.
Verify the date and scope of the last export test.
If gap: document the exports and schedule a reversibility test.
